title: Potion Format
description: Restores the classic pre-1.19.3 status effect display.
body:
This mod restores the old effect timer format from Minecraft versions 1.19.2 and earlier. In Minecraft 1.19.3 and newer, the effect timer is displayed as **00:00**, **∞**. With this mod, the timer is reverted to its previous style, showing **0:00**, **ˣˣ:ˣˣ**, for a more familiar and classic experience.
